args.body: After confirming the lease, advance SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS using the verified-handoff manifest and paired reports, the private reply draft and the administrative Interac workflow. Reuse equivalent terms if present. Produce the private EN/FR fixed-scope quote and test it against the existing eligible fictional inquiry and live-database exclusion. Specify what the buyer receives beyond the free tool, when to decline before acceptance, and one provisional CAD price with effort and cost assumptions. Save and read back the terms and verification, then close under valid ownership with a lesson. No quote issuance, contact, spending or publication.

description: The community SQLite directory explicitly invites pull requests, which gives the tested diagnostic a concrete referral route to evaluate. Recent maintainer activity and listing fit still need verification. In parallel, prepare a provisional CAD quote for a buyer-specific diagnosis using the verified SQLite reports. Available commercial feedback shows no new interpreted signal and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is unfunded with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The quote requires operator approval and an eligible inquiry before issuance. Any public deployment remains subject to host-enforced independent review.
